name: Organization
description: Read and add the people who can sign in to the organization the plugin is serving.

capabilities.name: List login accounts
capabilities.description: List active members of this organization (id and display name). Maps to kernel command org::members.

capabilities.name: Create a login
capabilities.description: Create an account with a generated password, or add an existing account, in this organization. Maps to kernel command org::create_member. The plugin cannot choose the password.

capabilities.name: Invite someone to create an account
capabilities.description: Email a one-time link so a new person sets their own password, or add an existing account to this organization. Maps to kernel command org::invite.
